tagline: A digital bank with a personal touch
hero_kpi_rationale: The bank's primary revenue, heavily influenced by interest rates and asset growth, is the main driver of its financial performance and represents 1.57% of average assets in 2024.

kpis.name: Net interest income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the difference between interest earned and interest paid.
kpis.description: Net interest income increased due to improved interest margins and growth in assets under management, rising from 917M NOK in 2023 to 1174M NOK in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by margins and balance sheet size

kpis.name: Profit before tax
kpis.description: Profit before tax rose significantly in 2024 from 500M NOK to 663M NOK, driven by higher net interest income despite rising costs.

kpis.name: Cost/income ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of operating costs relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: The ratio improved from 45.3% in 2023 to 43.8% in 2024, reflecting better operational efficiency despite higher absolute expenses.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank.
kpis.description: Total assets increased significantly from 70,327M NOK in 2023 to 80,032M NOK in 2024, reflecting substantial expansion in banking activities.

kpis.name: CET1 ratio
kpis.explanation: Regulatory measure of financial strength, indicating the ratio of Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets.
kpis.description: The CET1 ratio improved from 17.0% in 2023 to 18.0% in 2024, reflecting a strong capital position and strengthened equity base.

kpis.name: Loan losses and provisions
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside for doubtful loans and realized loan losses.
kpis.description: Loan losses and provisions increased slightly from 54M NOK in 2023 to 59M NOK in 2024, representing 0.09% of average loans, reflecting a healthy credit portfolio.
kpis.signal: Low loss level despite slight increase

risks.title: Dependence on external IT providers
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the IT operations and vendor relationships section, with concerned language about outsourcing. The trend is stable, but reliance on key vendors increases criticality. The Technology category is central to the bank's digital operations.

risks.title: Risks related to the 100% digital banking model
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly identified in the Transparency and human rights section, with measured but clear language on potential exclusion. The trend is stable. The Industrial category reflects the bank's specific business model.

risks.title: Evolving AML-CFT compliance
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited in the Compliance section with strong language regarding potential sanctions. AML-CFT regulations are constantly evolving, increasing pressure. The Regulation category is critical for banks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of external systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit in dependence on IT vendors and the centrality of digital systems. Language emphasizes operational disruptions and loss of trust. The trend is upward with digitalization. Critical category.

risks.title: Integration of new services post-merger
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned through the merger with Kron AS and the addition of digital fund solutions. Language is neutral but implies integration challenges. Trend is stable. Competition category as it relates to differentiated offerings.

risks.title: Increasing regulatory pressure on sustainability
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described in the CSRD and sustainability section, with proactive language but recognition of future obligations. Trend is upward. Regulation category linked to new European standards.

risks.title: Reputation related to human rights in the supply chain
risks.score_rationale: The risk is addressed within the Transparency Act framework, with cautious language on potential violations. Trend is stable. Reputation category as it relates to ESG brand image.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or AI solutions in the annual report.
evidence: No reference to AI in products
Digital strategy focused on digitization, not AI
